adj_df = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

for _, row in adj_df.iterrows():
    b1 = row['borough']
    b2 = row['neighbor']
    adj_dict[b1].add(b2)
    adj_dict[b2].add(b1)

# Verify all boroughs have neighbors and print neighbor counts
print("Neighbor counts:")
for b in sorted(adj_dict.keys()):
    print(f"{b}: {len(adj_dict[b])} neighbors")
    
# Prepare energy values as a dictionary for fast lookup
energy_map = energy_df.set_index('borough')['Energy_value'].to_dict()

n = len(energy_df)
values = energy_df['Energy_value'].values
global_mean = np.mean(values)
global_var = np.var(values, ddof=1)  # sample variance

print(f"\nGlobal mean: {global_mean}")
print(f"Global sample variance: {global_var}")
print(f"n: {n}")

# Compute Gi* z-scores
results = []
for b in energy_df['borough']:
    local_area = adj_dict[b].union({b})
    W_i = len(local_area)
    local_sum = sum(energy_map[nb] for nb in local_area)
    numerator = local_sum - W_i * global_mean
    denominator = np.sqrt(global_var * W_i * (n - W_i) / n)
    z = numerator / denominator
    results.append((b, local_sum, W_i, z))

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results, columns=['borough', 'local_sum', 'W_i', 'z_score'])
results_df = results_df.sort_values('z_score', ascending=False)

print("\nGi* results sorted by z-score (descending):")
print(results_df.to_string(index=False))

# Identify hot/cold spots
hot = results_df[results_df['z_score'] > 1.96].copy()
cold = results_df[results_df['z_score'] < -1.96].copy()

print("\nHot spots (z > 1.96):")
print(hot.to_string(index=False))
print("\nCold spots (z < -1.96):")
print(cold.to_string(index=False))
